description: Tracing middleware ignores incoming W3C traceparent headers and starts new root traces, breaking distributed trace correlation.
spec_notes: TracingMiddleware.handle_request must pass extracted_ctx as parent_ctx to tracer.start_span.

repo_files.middleware.py:
"""HTTP tracing middleware."""

from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Tuple
from propagator import W3CTracePropagator
from tracer import Tracer


class TracingMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, tracer: Tracer):
        self.tracer = tracer

    def handle_request(self, headers: Dict[str, str], handler: Callable[[], Any]) -> Tuple[Any, Dict[str, str]]:
        extracted_ctx = W3CTracePropagator.extract(headers)
        # BUG: Ignores extracted_ctx and passes None to start_span,
        # creating a disconnected root trace instead of continuing the distributed trace!
        span = self.tracer.start_span("http_request", parent_ctx=None)
        try:
            result = handler()
        finally:
            span.finished = True
        out_headers: Dict[str, str] = {}
        W3CTracePropagator.inject(span.context, out_headers)
        return result, out_headers

tests.test_trace_propagation.py:
from tracer import Tracer
from middleware import TracingMiddleware
from propagator import W3CTracePropagator


def test_root_trace_creation():
    tracer = Tracer()
    mw = TracingMiddleware(tracer)
    res, out_headers = mw.handle_request({}, lambda: "OK")
    assert res == "OK"
    assert "traceparent" in out_headers
    ctx = W3CTracePropagator.extract(out_headers)
    assert ctx is not None
    assert len(ctx.trace_id) == 32
    assert len(ctx.span_id) == 16
    assert ctx.sampled is True


def test_distributed_trace_context_correlation_inheritance():
    tracer = Tracer()
    mw = TracingMiddleware(tracer)
    upstream_trace_id = "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
    upstream_span_id = "00f067aa0ba902b7"
    in_headers = {"traceparent": f"00-{upstream_trace_id}-{upstream_span_id}-01"}
    res, out_headers = mw.handle_request(in_headers, lambda: "DOWNSTREAM_RES")
    assert res == "DOWNSTREAM_RES"
    ctx = W3CTracePropagator.extract(out_headers)
    assert ctx is not None
    # CRITICAL: Trace ID must be preserved exactly across service hops!
    assert ctx.trace_id == upstream_trace_id
    # Span ID must be newly generated
    assert ctx.span_id != upstream_span_id


def test_invalid_traceparent_fallback_to_root():
    tracer = Tracer()
    mw = TracingMiddleware(tracer)
    in_headers = {"traceparent": "malformed-header-format"}
    res, out_headers = mw.handle_request(in_headers, lambda: "RECOVERED")
    ctx = W3CTracePropagator.extract(out_headers)
    assert ctx is not None
    assert len(ctx.trace_id) == 32


def test_multi_hop_chain_propagation():
    tracer = Tracer()
    service_a = TracingMiddleware(tracer)
    service_b = TracingMiddleware(tracer)
    service_c = TracingMiddleware(tracer)
    _, h_a = service_a.handle_request({}, lambda: "A")
    _, h_b = service_b.handle_request(h_a, lambda: "B")
    _, h_c = service_c.handle_request(h_b, lambda: "C")
    ctx_a = W3CTracePropagator.extract(h_a)
    ctx_b = W3CTracePropagator.extract(h_b)
    ctx_c = W3CTracePropagator.extract(h_c)
    assert ctx_a.trace_id == ctx_b.trace_id == ctx_c.trace_id
    assert ctx_a.span_id != ctx_b.span_id != ctx_c.span_id

"""HTTP tracing middleware."""

from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Tuple
from propagator import W3CTracePropagator
from tracer import Tracer


class TracingMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, tracer: Tracer):
        self.tracer = tracer

    def handle_request(self, headers: Dict[str, str], handler: Callable[[], Any]) -> Tuple[Any, Dict[str, str]]:
        extracted_ctx = W3CTracePropagator.extract(headers)
        span = self.tracer.start_span("http_request", parent_ctx=extracted_ctx)
        try:
            result = handler()
        finally:
            span.finished = True
        out_headers: Dict[str, str] = {}
        W3CTracePropagator.inject(span.context, out_headers)
        return result, out_headers
